references.used_for: Separate upper/lower mouth parts; preserve skin; verify closure interpolation and keep cavity within lips.
Separate opening and mouth form rather than scaling a single oval.

integration_notes: E9: every open upper mouth arch derives from the approved smileReference upper curves, with connected corners and unchanged aperture bounds. Upper lip and inset depth follow the new arch.
Teeth and tongues retain the approved whole reference paths. Teeth are repositioned against the new arch and share the cavity clip.
E7 90% open height, colors, lower lip wash, opacity, energy mapping and controllers stay unchanged. Round teeth remain hidden.
